title: Tryout control plane configuration
description: Configuration of the Tryout control plane. $defs/bootstrap is read from tryout.yaml at startup; $defs/settings is stored in Postgres as revisions, and tryout.yaml may hold it to seed an empty database. $defs/session_request is the agent API contract for POST /v1/sessions; it shares $defs/workload with the project definition.

bootstrap.description: Read from tryout.yaml at startup: listeners, agent TLS files and trusted proxies.

listen.description: Address the control plane listens on, as [host]:port.

admin_listen.description: Address of the admin listener (admin API behind a login, and /metrics), as [host]:port. Leave it out to turn the admin listener off. It may equal listen, which puts the admin on the public address.

admin_metrics_token.description: Bearer token Prometheus must send to read /metrics on the admin listener; write it as ${VAR}. Without it, /metrics is open to anyone who reaches admin_listen.

public_url.description: Origin at which visitors reach this control plane, as scheme://host[:port] with no path (https://tryout.example.org). The admin uses it to show the address to embed and to run the project preview; without it, the admin shows /embed/<project> alone and no preview.

admin_preview.description: Whether the admin's project page may run /embed/<project> in a frame, as a visitor would. A preview takes a slot through the queue. Needs public_url, and the admin's origin in embed_frame_ancestors.

agent_tls.description: Mutual TLS towards every agent: the control plane's client certificate and the CA that signs the agents' certificates. Paths are relative to this file's directory.

ca.description: PEM file of the CA that signs the agents' server certificates.

cert.description: PEM file of the control plane's client certificate (extended key usage clientAuth).

key.description: PEM file of the client certificate's private key.

client_ip.description: How the control plane finds a visitor's IP address, for the per-IP limits. Without trusted proxies, the address of the connection is used and forwarding headers are ignored.

trusted_proxies.description: CIDR blocks of the reverse proxies or tunnels in front of the control plane (10.0.0.0/8, fd00::/8, 192.0.2.1). Only they may report the client's address.

header.description: Header in which a trusted proxy puts the client's address (CF-Connecting-IP, X-Real-IP...). Defaults to X-Forwarded-For, read from the right.

settings.description: Stored in Postgres as revisions, applied without a restart: embedding, theme, limits, nodes and projects.

embed_frame_ancestors.description: Origins allowed to embed /embed/<project> in an iframe ('self' is always allowed).

theme.description: Look of the embed page, for every project. Leave it out for the default amber accent and no logo.

accent.description: Accent colour as #rrggbb: queue number, spinner, primary button, focus ring. Needs a contrast of at least 3:1 on the dark card.

logo.description: Logo shown at the top of the status card, 20 px high: a file in tryout.yaml, an asset in a stored revision.

file.description: SVG, PNG or WebP file of at most 64 KB, relative to this file's directory. Required in tryout.yaml.

asset.description: SHA-256 of a logo stored in the database, in lowercase hex. Written by the control plane in revisions; use file in tryout.yaml.

alt.description: Text read by screen readers in place of the logo, such as your name.

limits.description: Per-IP limits (IPv6: per /64), across all projects. 0 disables a limit.

live_tickets_per_ip.description: Tickets an IP may hold at once: waiting, starting or active.

new_tickets_per_ip.description: Tickets an IP may create within a sliding window, released ones included.

streams_per_ip.description: Event streams an IP may keep open at once, on each control plane instance.

projects.description: Projects by name; the name is the one used in /embed/<project>.

settings_document.description: A stored revision: the settings alone.

origin.description: A scheme and host, with an optional port and an optional leading wildcard label: https://example.org, https://*.example.org, http://localhost:3000.

agent_url.description: URL of the agent's private API, over mutual TLS: https://host[:port], without a path. The agent's certificate must name the host, unless server_name is set.

server_name.description: DNS name expected in the agent's certificate, when it differs from the host of agent_url (a tunnel, a local port forward). Also sent as SNI.

public_url.description: URL template loaded by the browser; {session} is replaced by the session id.

probe_url.description: URL template reachable from the control plane, to check that a session answers. Defaults to public_url.

max_sessions.description: Cap on concurrent sessions on the node, all projects combined.

title.description: Name shown to visitors in the session bar, the starting card and the tab title. Defaults to the project's key.

enabled.description: Whether visitors may start sessions. A paused project (false) refuses new tickets and its embed page says it is offline; tickets already queued or running are kept.

max_sessions.description: Concurrent sessions for this project. Later visitors wait in the queue.

workload.description: What runs in a session container. Shared by the configuration and the agent API.

allOf.description: A desktop serves its own page on its port, and runs the image as it is.
A terminal runs in the agent's ttyd when it says ttyd: agent, or sets neither ttyd nor port: ttyd listens where the agent says and serves under the base path, so no port and no strip_prefix.
Otherwise a terminal serves its own page (ttyd: image, or a port without ttyd, as before ttyd existed): it needs a port, and runs the image as it is.

image.description: Docker image, preferably pinned by digest.

ttyd.description: Terminal only. agent: the agent mounts its own ttyd and runs the image's command in it, so the image needs no web server. image: the image serves its own page on port. Defaults to image when port is set, else agent.

command.description: Terminal with the agent's ttyd only: the program ttyd runs, as an argument list. Defaults to the image's entrypoint and command.

port.description: HTTP port of an image that serves its own page: required for a desktop and a terminal with ttyd: image; a terminal without ttyd that sets it serves its own page. Not allowed with the agent's ttyd.

runtime.description: Container runtime (runsc, runc...). Defaults to the node's runtime. Outside the dev profile, the agent accepts only runsc unless ALLOW_RUNC=true.

strip_prefix.description: Strip /s/<id> before forwarding, for an application that cannot serve under a base path. Not allowed for a terminal with the agent's ttyd.

limits.description: Resource limits; defaults depend on the kind.

env.description: Project environment variables. Variables set by the agent are reserved.

reserved_env.description: Variables set by the agent, which a project cannot override. Must match the agent's locked environment.
